LanguageData.LP_Sub_ArcaneArcher.label: Arcane Archer
LanguageData.LP_Sub_ArcaneArcher.description: An archer who pours arcane power into arrows and bullets: shooting damage with ranged weapons rises with fighter level, can fire three arcane shots (grasping, bursting, shadow), is deadlier at long range, and finally calls down a storm of arrows. Arcane shots all fire a guaranteed-hit shot from your current weapon and require a ranged weapon.
